# clickup_chat_channel (Resource)

Manages a ClickUp Chat channel via the V3 API.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the Channel.
- `workspace_id` (String) The ID of the Workspace.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the Channel.
- `topic` (String) The topic of the Channel.
- `user_ids` (List of String) User IDs to add to the channel (up to 100).
- `visibility` (String) The visibility of the Channel. One of `PUBLIC`, `PRIVATE`.

### Read-Only

- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the channel is archived.
- `channel_id` (String) The ID of the Channel.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp of when the channel was created.
- `creator` (String) ID of the user who created the channel.
- `type` (String) The type of the channel (CHANNEL, DM, GROUP_DM).
